newsitem.title: UK: BZW appoints new global derivatives head.
newsitem.headline: BZW appoints new global derivatives head.

text.p: British investment bank BZW said on Thursday it had appointed Jerry Del Missier as global head of derivatives within its Global Markets Division.
Del Missier will join BZW in early June from Bankers Trust where he has been managing director of derivatives products in charge of European business since 1992, BZW said in a statement.
Del Missier will be located at BZW's global headquarters in London and will report to Bob Diamond, chief executive of the Global Markets Division, the statement said.
BZW is the investment banking arm of Britain's Barclays Plc .
